description: Test everything from this unit! Master B2 level phrases: necessity (il faut que), wishes (je veux que), emotions (je suis content que), hypotheticals (si j'étais...), regrets (si j'avais su...), and more advanced expressions.
can_do: Express complex ideas with subjunctive mood
Use hypothetical and conditional structures fluently
Communicate at B2 level with nuance and precision
